cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?

mechanism: A organizes picnic evaluation by offering to count while pressing for the comparison scale, A rank and the evaluator incentive.
confusable: Unlike asking only whether guests enjoyed it, A seeks the operative measure and what B gets from a favorable result.
comparison: Picnic totals and committee money differ from an election supporter trading votes for car-park work.
seedUse: D198-a fun, organiser comparison and clipboard; S02-a takes counting to keep the evaluator engaged.
